entries.title: The Unfinished Pyramid
entries.origin: Reverse of the US Dollar — Novus Ordo Seclorum
entries.body: Programme of a new secular order. The eye above the incomplete pyramid signals an unfinished project — a world still being constructed toward an endpoint. The capstone floats because it was never meant to land.
entries.inversion: The dollar does not display a completed symbol. It displays a declaration of intent. Unsigned. Undated. Ongoing.

entries.title: The Signal Tower
entries.origin: Communications Infrastructure — Surveillance Architecture
entries.body: Who controls the signal controls the message. The electromagnetic spectrum as broadcast domination. Those who were only receivers become broadcasters. The frequency was always available — it was merely jammed.
entries.inversion: The tower was built to control the signal. The signal now belongs to anyone who transmits.

entries.title: Five Seals. One Eye.
entries.origin: US Dollar — Vatican — Freemasonry — East India Company — Yale University
entries.body: Five institutions. No documented connection. One symbol. The eye above the triangle appears on the US dollar, Vatican documents, Masonic certificates, East India Company seals, and Yale crests. Independently. Across centuries.
entries.inversion: They didn't invent the symbol. They inherited it. From something older.

entries.title: The Owl in the Institutions
entries.origin: Bohemian Grove — Athens — Yale — US Dollar
entries.body: The owl appears where power concentrates. Bohemian Grove. The Athenian drachma. The Yale seal. The micro-print on the US dollar. The symbol of Athena — goddess of wisdom and strategic warfare — adopted by every elite institution that followed.
entries.inversion: The symbol was never hidden. It was placed in plain sight. For those who were meant to see it.

entries.title: The Unfinished Tower
entries.origin: Tower of Babel — Freemasonic Temple — Institutional Architecture
entries.body: They keep building the same tower. It is never finished. The Tower of Babel. Solomon's Temple. The unfinished pyramid. The Washington Monument. The pattern is not architectural — it is doctrinal. The unfinished structure signals a work still in progress.
entries.inversion: The tower is not architecture. It is a declaration. We are here. We reach higher than you.

entries.title: The Double-Headed Eagle
entries.origin: Byzantine Empire — 33rd Degree Freemasonry — Dual Sovereignty
entries.body: One eagle. Two heads. It appears on every empire that ever existed. Byzantine. Austro-Hungarian. Russian Tsarist. Serbian. Albanian. The 33rd degree of Scottish Rite Freemasonry. Left and right. East and West. Two heads of the same body.
entries.inversion: Power does not reinvent its language. It passes it down.

entries.title: The 13s on the Dollar
entries.origin: US Great Seal — Reverse of the Dollar — Numerological Design
entries.body: Count everything on the US dollar. It adds to 13. Every time. 13 stars above the eagle. 13 stripes on the shield. 13 arrows. 13 olive branches. 13 leaves. 13 berries. 13 levels on the pyramid. The number is not coincidental.
entries.inversion: The designer did not repeat a number by accident. Numbers are language. This one was intentional.

entries.title: MK-Ultra Was Real
entries.origin: CIA — 1953–1973 — Declassified 1977 — Church Committee
entries.body: The government ran a mind control programme for 20 years. It was confirmed in court. MK-Ultra: CIA-administered LSD, hypnosis, electroconvulsive therapy, and psychological torture — conducted on unwitting US and Canadian citizens. The files were ordered destroyed in 1973.
entries.inversion: The files were ordered destroyed. The existence of the programme is now public record. What was in the destroyed files remains the question.

entries.title: The Church Committee
entries.origin: US Senate — 1975 — Frank Church — Intelligence Oversight
entries.body: In 1975 the US Senate confirmed the CIA had been running domestic operations for decades. Senator Frank Church called the CIA a rogue elephant operating outside the law. The Committee proposed ending the agency entirely. The agency remained. The committee was dissolved.
entries.inversion: He said this as a warning. The warning is on the public record. The operations continued.

entries.title: The Smedley Butler Confession
entries.origin: Major General Smedley Butler — War Is A Racket — 1935
entries.body: The most decorated US Marine in history said war is a racket. He was the one running it. Major General Smedley Butler: twice awarded the Medal of Honor. In 1935 he published War Is A Racket — documenting how military force serves corporate financial interests. He also reported a fascist coup plot against FDR to Congress.
entries.inversion: The confession is 90 years old. It is in print. The school curriculum does not include it.

entries.title: The Fed Is Not Federal
entries.origin: Federal Reserve — 1913 — Jekyll Island — G. Edward Griffin
entries.body: The Federal Reserve is not a government agency. A federal court confirmed this. Lewis v. United States, 1982: the Federal Reserve Banks are privately owned institutions. The name is the misdirection. The structure is a private banking cartel granted public authority by Congress in 1913.
entries.inversion: The name is the misdirection. The court language is the correction. The correction is 40 years old.

entries.title: Operation Northwoods
entries.origin: Joint Chiefs of Staff — 1962 — Declassified 1997 — JFK Archive
entries.body: In 1962 the US military proposed staging terror attacks on American citizens to justify a war. Operation Northwoods: a proposal signed by every member of the Joint Chiefs of Staff to conduct false flag attacks on US soil, blame Cuba, and use public outrage to justify invasion. President Kennedy rejected it.
entries.inversion: The proposal existed. The signatories existed. The archive is open.

entries.title: The Quigley Confession
entries.origin: Carroll Quigley — Tragedy and Hope — 1966 — Georgetown University
entries.body: A Georgetown professor documented the global power network from inside it. Carroll Quigley taught history at Georgetown for decades. His students included Bill Clinton, who cited him by name in his 1992 nomination speech. In Tragedy and Hope Quigley described a network whose goal was to create a world system of financial control — and called it good.
entries.inversion: The insider documented the network. The documentation is in print. The curriculum does not include it.

entries.title: The 28 Pages
entries.origin: 9/11 Commission — 2002 — Classified 2002 — Declassified 2016
entries.body: Twenty-eight pages of the 9/11 Commission report were classified for 13 years. The families of victims campaigned for their release from 2002 to 2016. When released, the pages documented connections between the Saudi government and the 9/11 hijackers that the Commission did not include in its public findings.
entries.inversion: What a government classifies reveals as much as what it discloses. Sometimes more.

entries.title: The All-Seeing Eye
entries.origin: Eye of Horus — Ancient Egypt — 3,000 BCE — US Dollar 1935
entries.body: The eye on the dollar is 4,000 years older than the United States. The Eye of Horus: protection of the pharaoh, connection to divine authority, 3,000 BCE. Adopted into Western esoteric tradition through Hermetic and Alchemical texts. It appears on the reverse of the US dollar for the first time in 1935 — placed there by Henry Wallace, Vice President and Freemason.
entries.inversion: The symbol was not chosen for its history. It was chosen by someone who knew its history.

entries.title: The Obelisk — What It Actually Means
entries.origin: Ancient Egypt — Benben Stone — Solar Cult — Rome — Washington DC
entries.body: Every major capital has one. No government explains why. The obelisk originates in ancient Egypt — a Benben stone, a symbol of the rays of Ra, positioned at temple entrances as a transmitter between earth and the divine. Rome transported 13 Egyptian obelisks at the height of the Empire. The Vatican placed one at the centre of St Peter's Square. Washington built the tallest in the world.
entries.inversion: The symbol moved with power. Not by coincidence. By design.

entries.title: The Fasces — Still in Plain Sight
entries.origin: Ancient Rome — Magistrate Authority — US House of Representatives
entries.body: The symbol of fascism is displayed in the US House of Representatives. Both sides of the podium. The fasces: a bundle of rods bound around an axe, symbol of a magistrate's authority to punish and execute in ancient Rome. Mussolini's movement adopted it as its name and symbol in 1919. Two bronze fasces remain mounted on the walls of the US House Chamber.
entries.inversion: The symbol of magistrate authority over life and death is displayed at the seat of American legislative power. It has never been removed.

entries.title: The Skull — Secret Society Emblem
entries.origin: Freemasonic Ritual — Skull and Bones 1832 — Yale University
entries.body: The skull and crossbones was not a pirate symbol. It was an initiation emblem first. The skull appears in Masonic ritual as a symbol of mortality and initiation. Skull and Bones, founded at Yale in 1832, counts among its confirmed members two Presidents, multiple CIA directors, senators, and Supreme Court justices.
entries.inversion: The skull was an initiation symbol before it was a flag. The society kept the original meaning.

entries.title: The Phoenix — Not the Eagle
entries.origin: US Great Seal — 1782 — Charles Thomson — Freemasonic Symbolism
entries.body: The bird on the original US Great Seal was not an eagle. It was a phoenix. The phoenix — a bird that dies and rises from its own ashes, ancient Egyptian in origin — represents in Freemasonic symbolism the destruction of the old order and rise of the new. Charles Thomson, designer of the Great Seal, was documented as familiar with esoteric symbolism. The bird was redesigned as an eagle in the final version.
entries.inversion: The phoenix was the first choice. The eagle was the revision. What the revision retained was intentional.

entries.title: The Compass and Square
entries.origin: Freemasonry — Operative Masonry — Sacred Geometry — Washington DC
entries.body: The most recognised secret society symbol is a builder's tool. The building it refers to is not physical. The compass draws the circle — the boundary of the self. The square tests the right angle — ethical conduct. The G at centre stands for both Geometry and God. Washington DC was designed as a temple. The tools are in the street grid.
entries.inversion: The city was designed as a temple. The tools are in the street grid. The blueprint is the map.

entries.title: The Rothschild Map
entries.origin: Mayer Amschel Rothschild — 1760s — Five Sons — Five Central Banks
entries.body: Every central bank in the world was created using the same model. Designed by one family. Mayer Amschel Rothschild founded a banking dynasty in Frankfurt in the 1760s. His five sons were placed in London, Paris, Frankfurt, Vienna, and Naples — each establishing a central banking relationship with the sovereign power of that nation. Carroll Quigley documented this network in Tragedy and Hope.
entries.inversion: The network was not a conspiracy. It was a business model. Documented. Successful. Ongoing.
